![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14216491/assets/5780b9e67272fdd78a24aab108fb9c672ee76ff2d62376991cea03c7efaa81fe.png)

Evaluate the triple integral 
${∭}_{R}\frac{z}{12}\,dV$
over the region $R,$ shown above.

*Hint: All surfaces, except for the front one, are parallel to the corresponding coordinate planes.*
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14216491/assets/240cc6d74e266579aa848be820fd0014672aa0654f079c079472a896ad44c5fe.png)

 

Notice that our solid can be written as the type II region

$$
R=\{(x,y,z)\,:\,(y,z)\in D,\,\,0\le x\le 4-y+2z\},
$$

where

$$
D=\{(y,z)\,:\,0\le y\le 4,\,\,0\le z\le 3\}
$$

is the projection of $R$ onto the $yz$-plane, shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14216491/assets/27862dcc3effe5801c812f5c8944c0134d13bb38f99d337b0a4e20e9ff815639.png)

Hence, we can express the region $R$ as

$$
R=\{(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le y\le 4,\,\,0\le z\le 3,\,\,0\le x\le 4-y+2z\}
$$

As a result, by writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}\frac{z}{12}\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{4-y+2z}\frac{z}{12}\,dx\,dz\,dy.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x$, treating $y$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{4-y+2z}\frac{z}{12}\,dx\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}[{\int }_{0}^{4-y+2z}\frac{z}{12}\,dx]dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{z}{12}[x]_{x=0}^{x=4-y+2z}\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{z}{12}(4-y+2z)\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{1}{12}(4z-yz+2{z}^{2})\,dz\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{1}{12}(4z-yz+2{z}^{2})\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{4}[{\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{1}{12}(4z-yz+2{z}^{2})\,dz]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{12}{[2{z}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}y{z}^{2}+\frac{2}{3}{z}^{3}]}_{z=0}^{z=3}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}\frac{1}{12}(18-\frac{9}{2}y+18)\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}(3-\frac{3}{8}y)\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}(3-\frac{3}{8}y)\,dy & ={[3y-\frac{3}{16}{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=4} \\  & =(12-3)-0 \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
